application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: As on 01-10-2026, a candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 34 years.

qualification.details: Candidates must be eligible as per the rules of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996.

salary_details.details: Remuneration shall be paid as fixed by the Government from time to time on a contract basis as per Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996 for a period of one year.

Qualified candidates from the typewriting test (or shortlisted candidates if applications exceed 20) will be called for an oral interview.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application form from the official website at https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/mulugu.
Fill out the application form completely with all required details.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph onto the designated space in the application form.

Enclose attested copies of academic qualification certificates, marks lists, pass certificates, provisional certificates, technical qualifications, date of birth certificate, community certificate (if applicable), and local/non-local candidature certificate.
Enclose a self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgment worth Rs. 25/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD.
Place the application and enclosures in a sealed cover.
Superscribe the envelope and address it to the PRL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, MULUGU.
Send the sealed cover exclusively by way of Speed post or courier on or before 22-10-2026 by 05:00 p.m. Applications sent directly or in person will not be entertained.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely on a contract basis under Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for a period of one year (noted as two years under General Instructions point 1) on executing a deed of agreement. Applications received after 05:00 p.m. on 22-10-2026 will not be accepted. The contract appointment shall automatically cease to be in operation unless a fresh proposal is made and a fresh contract is entered into. No TA and DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment. Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected. No correspondence will be entertained in any respect. Candidates resorting to bring influence of any kind will be disqualified summarily. The Principal District Judge and Sessions Judge, Mulugu reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Typist post under this recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be eligible as per the rules of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996.

rows.qualification_required: Must have passed Bachelor's Degree from any recognized University in India established or Incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any equivalent qualification. Must have passed Telangana Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting by higher grade qualification or its equivalent examination. Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation.

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 01-10-2026, a candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 34 years.

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Salary
content_sections.text: Remuneration shall be paid as fixed by the Government from time to time on a contract basis as per Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996 for a period of one year.

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a test in Typewriting regarding technical efficiency, followed by an oral interview for qualified candidates. In the event of more than 20 applications received, applications will be shortlisted based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination as per rules, and qualified candidates will be called for an oral interview. A test in Typewriting to assess technical efficiency for the post of Typist. Qualified candidates from the typewriting test (or shortlisted candidates if applications exceed 20) will be called for an oral interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Court Mulugu
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and application form from the official website at https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/mulugu. Fill out the application form completely with all required details. Affix a recent passport-size photograph onto the designated space in the application form. Enclose attested copies of academic qualification certificates, marks lists, pass certificates, provisional certificates, technical qualifications, date of birth certificate, community certificate (if applicable), and local/non-local candidature certificate. Enclose a self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgment worth Rs. 25/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD. Place the application and enclosures in a sealed cover. Superscribe the envelope and address it to the PRL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, MULUGU. Send the sealed cover exclusively by way of Speed post or courier on or before 22-10-2026 by 05:00 p.m. Applications sent directly or in person will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificates of academic qualifications such as marks lists, pass certificates, provisional certificates, testimonials, and other certificates Technical qualification certificates Date of Birth Certificate Community Certificate in cases of SCs/STs/BCs/EWS issued by the competent authority Certificate in respect of Local / Non-Local candidature in terms of Presidential Order, 1975 A self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgment worth Rs. 25/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD

content_sections.heading: District Court Mulugu Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a contract basis under Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for a period of one year (noted as two years under General Instructions point 1) on executing a deed of agreement. Applications received after 05:00 p.m. on 22-10-2026 will not be accepted. The contract appointment shall automatically cease to be in operation unless a fresh proposal is made and a fresh contract is entered into. No TA and DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment. Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected. No correspondence will be entertained in any respect. Candidates resorting to bring influence of any kind will be disqualified summarily. The Principal District Judge and Sessions Judge, Mulugu reserves the right to cancel the notification without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is District Court Mulugu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: District Court Mulugu Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment notification issued to fill 1 Typist post on a contract basis in the Fast Track Special Court for Expeditious Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Mulugu.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Typist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 22-10-2026 up to 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Typist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university, passed the Telangana Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting by higher grade (or equivalent), and possess knowledge or qualification in computer operation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for District Court Mulugu Typist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 34 years of age as on 01-10-2026, subject to category-wise age relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit my application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent in a sealed cover addressed to the PRL. District and Sessions Judge, Mulugu by way of speed post or courier. Direct or in-person submissions are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a technical efficiency test in Typewriting followed by an oral interview. If more than 20 applications are received, candidates will be shortlisted based on qualifying examination marks before being called for the oral interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Typist post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 19,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this appointment is made strictly on a contract basis for a period of one year under Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Rules, 1996.
